item.title: ‎Google Gemini
item.description: Meet Gemini, Google’s AI assistant. Get help with writing, planning, brainstorming, and more. Experience the power of generative AI.

item.title: ‎Google Gemini
item.description: 認識 Gemini，Google 的 AI 助理助你寫作、規劃和集思廣益等。體驗生成式 AI 的強大功能。

item.title: Gemini – Your AI assistant from Google
item.description: Gemini Live is now built into your chat, so you can switch seamlessly between talking and typing. As you talk, show Gemini what you’re seeing and try saying “reimagine this” to dream up creative new surroundings with Nano Banana.

item.title: Gemini — Google DeepMind
item.description: “Gemini 4 represents a step change in what AI can accomplish in real-world science. We've seen it reason through complex experimental data, from cellular imaging to mass spectrometry, and make subtle findings that traditionally require expert scientists to identify.

item.title: Gemini for desktop: download the AI app for Windows & macOS
item.description: Download Gemini for desktop on Windows and macOS. A native AI assistant with global shortcuts and automation to help you research, write, and summarize files.

item.title: Gemini 融入工作 - 商用 AI 資源和提示 | Google Workspace
item.description: Gemini 令工作更得心應手 Gemini 是採用 AI 技術的 Google 智能助理，不但是 Gmail、文件和試算表等的內置工具，更具備企業級安全和私隱保障。 探索如何與 Gemini 協作，助您專注發揮所長。

item.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro - Google DeepMind
item.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro understands design intent, converting static SVGs into animated, code-based graphics for faster, cleaner web development. Your browser does not support the video tag.

item.title: Trade Crypto, Predict Outcomes & Earn — All in One Platform | Gemini
item.description: The crypto super app for trading, predicting, and earning. Buy 90+ cryptos, trade prediction markets, and earn with staking and the Gemini Credit Card.

item.title: Gemini API - Interactions API | Google AI for Developers
item.description: 借助 Gemini API，从快速提示到生产应用和智能体，一气呵成。 使用 Gemini 处理复杂的编码和多模态推理，或将多步骤工作交给托管式智能体。 使用 Live API 流式传输语音和视频，或使用 Nano Banana 生成图片、使用 Gemini Omni 生成视频、使用 Lyria 生成音乐。

item.title: Gemini (聊天機器人) - 维基百科，自由的百科全书
item.description: [90][91] 2026年5月的Google I/O大會推出了Gemini 3.5 Flash。 2026年7月21日推出了Gemini 3.6 Flash及Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite，提升了編碼、知識工作與多模態表現，而Token用量減少17%，並且降低延遲與成本。 [92]
